property_summary: For every caller A and amount v that A might attempt to withdraw, the reference contract C ensures that a non-owner calling withdraw(v) reverts (so a non-owner cannot change address(c).balance); the mutant removing onlyOwner allows some non-owner to successfully withdraw and thus can make address(c).balance smaller for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Remove the require check so any caller can invoke withdraw, changing who can withdraw and thus observed balance after withdraw.
